description: PAID (needs a key) — Use when your user wants to know whether e-mail addresses can receive mail before writing to them. 0.3 credits per address (an address checked in the last 7 days costs nothing), so a call costs at most its addresses × that — a fixed price, no estimate: is the e-mail address deliverable (valid, invalid, catch_all, unknown)? Up to 25 addresses per call, answered at once.
name: verify_email
title: Verify e-mails
